content: The "overall risk score for the collection" is calculated by multiplying the CPI (Artifact Condition and Preservation Index) by the ERF (Environmental Risk Factor) for each artifact, and then taking the maximum of these calculated scores across all artifacts. The CPI is derived from the artifact's rating profile and conservation status, while the ERF is based on various environmental factors like light, temperature, humidity, vibration, and pollutants.

args.sql:
WITH cpi_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        ac."ARTregID",
        ar."HIST_sign" + (ar.rating_profile->>'research_score')::int + (ar.rating_profile->>'cultural_score')::int as sum_ratings,
        CASE ac.conserve_status
            WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
            WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
            WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
            WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
            WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
            ELSE NULL
        END as conserve_val
    FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac
    JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ac."ARTregID" = ar."ART_link"
    WHERE ac.conserve_status IS NOT NULL AND ac.conserve_status != 'None'
),
erf_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        sd."ART_link",
        AVG(
            COALESCE(CASE sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'light'
                WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE NULL END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'humidity'
                WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE NULL END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'vibration'
                WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE NULL END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'pollutants'
                WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE NULL END, 0) +
            COALESCE(CASE sd.env_handling_sensitivity->'environment'->>'temperature'
                WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 ELSE NULL END, 0)
        ) / 5.0 as erf
    FROM "SensitivityData" sd
    GROUP BY sd."ART_link"
),
avs_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        cc."ARTregID",
        (((cc.sum_ratings) * (10 - cc.conserve_val)) / 30.0) * ec.erf as avs
    FROM cpi_calc cc
    JOIN erf_calc ec ON cc."ARTregID" = ec."ART_link"
)
SELECT b.art_title, b."DYNASTY"
FROM (SELECT "ARTregID" FROM avs_scores ORDER BY avs DESC LIMIT 1) a
JOIN "ArtifactsCore" b ON a."ARTregID" = b."ARTregID";
